facts: Parties: Bellhaven Analytics Ltd (Buyer), Redcliffe Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Northgate Analytics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 24 March 2027; Closing is scheduled for 8 May 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $31,875,000. The Purchase Price is $170,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 24 March 2027), either party may terminate.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Glenrock Analytics Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 6 August 2027.
